companies.name: Ather Energy

CLSA raised its FY27/28 volume estimates by 27%/16% and its TP to Rs1,600. Nomura raised its TP to Rs1,714 and says margin risks are behind. JP expects positive consensus revisions (CLSA, Nomura, JP).

1Q27.ebitdaNote: EBITDA of Rs36bn (+45% YoY) was 4.4% above consensus; margin of 20.9% (+113bps YoY, +9bps QoQ) beat the 20.2% consensus despite ~4.5% commodity cost inflation, offset by the 2.3% price hike, export realisations, operating leverage and lower discretionary spend (other costs 5.5% of sales vs 6.1% expected). (Nomura, CLSA)

(Nomura, CLSA, Bern)

1Q27.ebitdaNote: Consolidated EBITDA of Rs15.9bn (+32% yoy) was ~4% above consensus of Rs15.3bn (2.8% above Kotak), driven by better ASPs and lower other expenses (10.7% of sales vs 12% expected), partly offset by weaker gross margin (RM/sales 58.5%, +290bps qoq); EBITDA margin 24.0%, in line with consensus (Nomura, Kotak).

outlook.note: Management sees enquiries strong and expects strong growth to continue. Capacity rises from 120k to 132k units/month from July, towards 1.65mn by Oct-26 and 2mn by Mar-27. companies.name: Maruti Suzuki
companies.note: MSIL expects its domestic volumes to rise 10% in FY27 (JEFe: 15%). MSIL said it had just ~13 days of channel stocks at end of Jun-Q. Maruti Suzuki’s relatively more gradual price hike strategy vs peers as it prioritizes volume growth over margin in the near term. Management guided for ~10% domestic volume growth in FY27  but could  surprise on upside and deliver mid teens growth – Low channel inventory, 130k orderback log (vs 190k in March), rise in first time buyers, 500k capacity add and upgraded Breeza with 1litre engine (thus lower pricing vs earlier model) to drive growth.

(GS, Jeff, Bern)

companies.name: Asian Paints
